title: Crash/hang with reflection probe and clearcoat using mobile renderer
body:
### Tested versions

- Not reproducible in 4.6.2
- Reproducible in 4.7.dev1, 4.7.dev4 (other 4.7 versions not tested)

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable.mono - Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS 24.04 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1240P (16 threads) - 46.76 GiB memory

### Issue description

Hard crash when loading a scene containing a ReflectionProbe node and a MeshInstance3D with a material that has Clearcoat enabled, whether created in 4.6 or 4.7. 

Issues do not seem to occur using the Forward+ renderer.

Also appears to hang indefinitely when adding the ReflectionProbe node in the 4.7.x editor. 

Side note: adding the ReflectionProbe node and _then_ enabling Clearcoat in the material did NOT cause a crash.

Side note 2: loading the repro scene caused a crash when I tested with 4.7.dev1 .NET, but caused an indefinite hang with 4.7.dev1 standard. All other tests performed with .NET version.

### Steps to reproduce

To cause a hang:
1. Using Godot 4.7, create a 3D scene.
2. Add a MeshInstance3D, with a BoxMesh that has a standard material.
3. Enable Clearcoat on the material. (Roughness value does not appear to change anything.)
4. Add a ReflectionProbe node to the scene.
5. Observe hang.

To cause a crash:
1. Have a project that's already created that contains the above setup - can use 4.6 for this, or 4.7 but enabling clearcoat after adding the reflection probe node.
2. Open the project in 4.7.x.
3. Open the relevant scene (in MRP it's `main.tscn`).
3. Observe crash.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[clearcoat-reflectionprobe-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26714205/clearcoat-reflectionprobe-mrp.zip)
